The plate holds about 10 roasted potato chunks, and I estimated the weight from their apparent size.

Each chunk is roughly 12–15 g, which puts the total near 130 g. Roasted potatoes with a little oil come to about 1.2 kcal/g, which gives about 155 kcal.
